## Overview

I focused on bringing data into R from multiple sources, cleaning it, and exporting useful results.

The assignment mirrors a common workplace reality: business data often arrives from spreadsheets, copied tables, web pages, or external systems, and each source needs a slightly different cleaning process.

## Skills Demonstrated

- Importing CSV and Excel files.
- Cleaning clipboard data with missing value placeholders.
- Exporting data to CSV and Excel.
- Scraping IMDb Top 250 movie information from an archived webpage.
- Working with labelled SPSS data.
- Combining education and GDP indicators for analysis.

## Value

Import and export skills are essential for real analytics workflows because useful business data rarely arrives in one clean format.

This project also helped me think about reproducibility. Cleaned data and saved plots can be shared with others, included in reports, or used as inputs for later analysis.
